title: Core skeleton: types, HTML shell, util, CLI, public API
notes: Extend pre-existing package.json/tsconfig skeleton. Define AST types, HTML escape + renderDocument skeleton, tab expansion helper, improve renderMarkdown to call parseDocument from blocks/index and renderDocument. Do not implement block/inline parsers here; blocks/index is owned by task-08 (stub may exist in repo).

title: Block parsers: paragraphs and document line splitting
notes: Implement paragraph blocks and shared line splitting helpers. Export BlockParser tryParse functions; wiring task integrates into blocks/index.ts.

title: Block parsers: ATX/Setext headings and thematic breaks
notes: Implement heading and hr tryParse exports. Headings use parseInlines from inline/index when available; export APIs only — task-08 wires order.

title: Block parsers: indented and fenced code blocks
notes: 4-space indented code and ``` fenced blocks with optional info string. No inline parsing inside code; preserve literal newlines for HTML rendering.

title: Block parsers: block quotes and lists
notes: Nested block quotes and ordered/unordered lists including tight/loose items. Export tryParse helpers; wiring task integrates.

title: Inline: textual content, escapes, and line breaks
notes: Plain text runs, backslash escapes, hard/soft breaks. Export inline parser hooks; task-08 registers in inline/index.ts.

title: Inline: emphasis, code spans, links, and images
notes: Implement emphasis/strong with delimiter rules, code spans, autolinks and bracket links, images. Respect precedence vs escapes and code; export parsers for wiring task.

title: Wire block and inline parsers into orchestrators
notes: Implement parseDocument/parseBlocks and parseInlines: import all block/inline modules, register tryParse order per CommonMark, connect to types and html renderer. Ensure tab expansion is applied where needed before parsing.
